tldr: Moon in the 4th house routes emotional safety through home and roots.
body: With the Moon in the 4th house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. This makes what makes you feel rooted, protected, and emotionally held a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through home and roots.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in home and roots.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
